_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' DDRaceNetwork egg (MIT).
name: DDNet
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: DDraceNetwork, the cooperative racing mod of Teeworlds. Installs the release you choose from ddnet.org; your own settings go in myServerconfig.cfg.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# DDNet. Downloads the Linux release from ddnet.org and checks it against
# ddnet.org's published SHA-256. Your settings (myServerconfig.cfg), maps
# and records are never touched; the server's files are only replaced once
# the new release has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

base=https://ddnet.org/downloads
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

page=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$base/") || fail "ddnet.org can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# The releases, newest first, as ddnet.org lists them.
versions=$(grep -oE 'DDNet-[0-9][0-9.]*-linux_x86_64\.tar\.xz' <<<"$page" | sed 's/^DDNet-//; s/-linux_x86_64\.tar\.xz$//' | awk '!seen[$0]++')
case "$want" in
latest) version=$(head -n 1 <<<"$versions") ;;
nightly) version=nightly ;;
*)
    grep -qxF "$want" <<<"$versions" ||
        fail "DDNet has no version $want. Set Version to latest, nightly, or a released version such as $(head -n 1 <<<"$versions")."
    version=$want
    ;;
esac
[ -n "$version" ] || fail "ddnet.org lists no Linux release right now. Reinstall to try again later."
file="DDNet-$version-linux_x86_64.tar.xz"
# ddnet.org's checksums (its list can lag a day behind a new release).
sum=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$base/sha256sums.txt" | awk -v f="$file" '$2 == f { print $1 }') || true

if [ "$version" != nightly ] && [ -x DDNet-Server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-ddnet 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $sum" ]; then
    echo "DDNet $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading DDNet $version"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/$file" "$base/$file" || fail "The download of DDNet $version failed. Reinstall to try again."
    if [ -z "$sum" ]; then
        [ "$version" = nightly ] || echo "ddnet.org has no checksum for DDNet $version yet, so the download can't be checked."
    elif [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$sum" ]; then
        fail "The download didn't match ddnet.org's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mkdir "$build/x"
    # The server and its data only, not the game client.
    tar -xJf "$build/$file" -C "$build/x" --strip-components=1 --wildcards '*/DDNet-Server' '*/data' '*/storage.cfg' '*/license.txt'
    cp -a "$build/x/." /mnt/server/
    chmod +x DDNet-Server
    echo "$version $sum" > .raptor-ddnet
fi

# The settings the server owns, read after the release's own
# data/autoexec_server.cfg (which updates replace).
if [ ! -f myServerconfig.cfg ]; then
    cat > myServerconfig.cfg <<'CFG'
# Your settings: updates never replace this file. The server's port, name,
# password, map and listing are set from the Startup page.
sv_port 8303
sv_name "My DDNet server"
password ""
sv_rcon_password ""
sv_map "Tutorial"
sv_register 0
CFG
fi
echo "Installed DDNet $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The DDNet release to install, such as 20.2.1, latest, or nightly.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The remote console password for admins. Empty makes a random one, shown in the console at start.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts with, from data/maps.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: 1 lists the server in the in-game server browser, 0 keeps it unlisted.
